Completed. docs/architecture/overview.md now documents the repo-local layering rule: the production architecture remains consolidated into Shell, Worker, and Contracts, while domain/application/infrastructure/presentation boundaries are enforced inside those projects. Completed. Worker console visibility toggling now hides the console window without freeing the console, keeps console streams rebound for the worker lifetime, disables the console close button to avoid killing the worker, opens with immediate optimistic UI feedback, and replays retained worker persistent logs once in the background when the console is first shown. Regression tests cover repeated toggles, immediate UI state, close-button disabling, and malformed persisted log lines.
